mechanism_narrative: The one-week collapse in TRANSIT to -21.3, on top of a two-week decline, removes the commuting demand that feeds street-facing retail, so RETAIL_REC stays below its recent 28-day mean over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT fell from -3.6 to -21.3 between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: TRANSIT remains below -15 for two consecutive weeks while the next-28-day mean of RETAIL_REC exceeds the last-28-day mean of -7.775.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL rising to +5.9 marks a completed stay-at-home substitution; once RESIDENTIAL crosses +4, discretionary trips are redirected away from retail and RETAIL_REC is held below its recent mean for two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean exceeds +4.0 percent above baseline
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL rose from +1.0 at t-3w to +5.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RESIDENTIAL stays above +4 for two weeks yet the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is higher than the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous collapse in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES, both dropping more than 12 points in the final week, identifies a hard mobility-restriction regime; the joint condition suppresses retail footfall for at least one further week before any easing can appear.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT -21.3 and WORKPLACES -16.9 in week t-0w
failure_condition: In the week after a joint TRANSIT and WORKPLACES fall above 10 points, RETAIL_REC rises rather than falls.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM at -13.4 sits 4.3 points above RETAIL_REC at -17.7, showing essentials-only shopping still functions; under an easing regime non-essential retail converges upward toward that grocery level within four weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM exceeds RETAIL_REC by more than 3 points
failure_condition: The GROCERY_PHARM-minus-RETAIL_REC gap stays above 3 points while the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean remains below -7.775.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS falling from +8.0 three weeks ago to -11.1 now shows outdoor leisure demand has been withdrawn; because park trips normally precede browsing-type retail excursions, RETAIL_REC remains below its recent mean over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped 19.1 points from t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: PARKS stays below -10 for two consecutive weeks while the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: If the restriction regime that produced the t-0w collapse is lifted within two weeks, TRANSIT stops falling and RETAIL_REC rebounds; the next-28-day mean then exceeds the last-28-day mean because that base mean is dragged down by a single crash week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT week-on-week change turns non-negative after two consecutive declines
evidence_refs: fact:last-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is -7.775 and includes the -17.7 crash week
failure_condition: TRANSIT turns non-negative within two weeks but the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean stays below -7.775.

mechanism_narrative: The +8.0 PARKS reading three weeks ago marks a seasonal outdoor-activity peak that also lifted RETAIL_REC; that peak has unwound to -11.1, so the recent-28-day mean sits above the seasonal trough the next four weeks will occupy.
candidate_trigger: PARKS peak-to-trough seasonal swing exceeds 15 points within four weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS swing from +8.0 at t-3w to -11.1 at t-0w
regime_hint: seasonal transition from outdoor peak to seasonal trough
failure_condition: PARKS recovers above +5 within three weeks and the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL exceeds +5 while PARKS falls below -10 in the same week, households reallocate trips from distant outdoor leisure to nearby errands, and local-format retail recaptures enough spend to lift RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above +5 and PARKS below -10 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:t-0w shows RESIDENTIAL +5.9 and PARKS -11.1 simultaneously
regime_hint: stay-at-home orders with essential retail open
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL is above +5 and PARKS below -10, the next-28-day RETAIL_REC mean is lower than the last-28-day mean.
